description: This file defines the HomeScreen widget for a Flutter application, displaying featured recipes and a list of all recipes using a masonry grid and horizontal list. It interacts with RecipeProvider for data and navigates to RecipeDetailScreen on recipe selection.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget displaying featured recipes and full catalog with masonry grid and horizontal list, supporting navigation to recipe details.

methods.name: _openRecipe
methods.description: Navigates to the RecipeDetailScreen with the selected recipe's ID.

methods.name: _masonryAspectRatioForIndex
methods.description: Returns varying aspect ratios for masonry grid tiles to create a modern look.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the HomeScreen, including header, featured recipes, and the all recipes masonry grid.
